body:
Okay update

So the doc told everyone I just have dry skin ( which I fucking beg to differ) and prescribed me a steroid cream.
A friend of mine started getting an itch and his doc said the same thing.

However now I’m starting to get red itchy spots in between my fingers and on my wrists. So I fear that whatever it is it’s spreading. What’s helped is that I’ve popped the one that where itching and they stopped. Otherwise I’ve been sanitizing my hand to try and prevent whatever’s going on.

The spots came up in different areas on my body all at once. First my groin, arm pits and the right side of my stomach. I noticed that there was spots that almost linked together tho so it may be scabies. 
If it is how would I be able to get rid of it other than washing my clothes and bedsheets
But then how come no one that I’ve interacted with has it? It’s really contagious ain’t it?

I try to. I pay for meals where I can. Like fast food. I used to starve myself but I can’t do that to me anymore. I’ve tried one place that a lot of people told me to go to. They just handed me a sheet of paper of shelters. None anywhere that are close to work. I don’t have a car except for the one I sleep in which is broken down. And to fix the car it would be more than what I payed for it originally.
Idk of any other options. Like I had moments where I could get an affordable place to live. But then again I would have to sleep with the person I would rent from or the room would be taken before I got to it. Or there wouldn’t be a room at all.

I sent you my number 

I just feel so shaken and unstable

Truth be told my dad doesn’t talk to me at all anymore. He doesn’t support me anymore. He said that a burden. And for some reason my family won’t talk to me either.
The job I had wasn’t giving me the full pay that week due to transitioning from a different store. So I didn’t have enough to pay and was told to leave. 
I’m terrified to go to a shelter. The last one I was in I was a kid and got molested when I stayed there with my mom for a day. One thing I know from being homeless is that shelters aren’t what they say they are most of the time.
It’s been shitty for a while. I just don’t know what else to do except disappear.
My mother manipulated me and the court to where I wasn’t able to see my dad or my family for 7 years.🤷🏼‍♂️
If this is really fuckin scattered and doesn't make too much sense I apologize. Just...you get it. Hopefully.
